name: odoo-installer
description: One-click installer for Odoo 15/17/19 development environments on Windows

scripts.dev: npx rimraf dist && npx tsc && copy dev-app-update.yml dist\dev-app-update.yml >nul 2>&1 & electron . --dev
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && tsc && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && tsc && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && tsc && electron-builder --publish always
